description:
Detective Jung Myeong-seok of Team 1 who does his best in his work.  
Myeong-seok is ordered to be suspended while protesting to his superior to end the case of sexual assault of a middle school girl he was in charge of.  
On the other hand, Sung-hee, who has been threatened and obstructed by Daegwang construction, decides to fight back to protect her pride and value of existence.  
The two become embroiled in a dangerous incident and fight against injustice.

**Original Webtoon:**
